narrative.overview:
The office day is a chase against an 8-hour target. The top band is a scoreboard that is glanced at, not a dashboard that is read: how long worked, how long to go, when to leave. Everything below the band is a plain ruled book of tasks and logs. There is no sidebar of navigation and no grid of stat cards.

One layout serves three themes. A theme changes type, palette, density, radius and one signature move; it never moves components around. The Chase (default) is a pitch-green band with gold and condensed numerals. Time Card is a manila punch-clock card with stamped figures. Graphite Console is a dark panel set split by hairline seams where colour only means state.
keyCharacteristics: A band at the top that holds the day's state; the body is quiet.
Three type sizes only for text: body 15, small 13, and the figure size (64 / 40 / 15 by theme).
Project colour is data: a 6px ribbon on every task and log row and the colour of each ball in the overs strip.
Flat and opaque. Depth comes from 1px lines, tonal steps and the band, not shadows.
Each theme sets every token itself, status colours included.

rules.name: The Band Ink Rule
rules.body: Inside the band, text, hover and focus tokens are remapped to the band's own ink, muted, line and focus colour. Pitch-green accent text would vanish on the Chase band, so controls there focus in gold.

rules.name: The Large Figures Rule
rules.body: Clock phase colours near, due and over pass 3:1 only. They colour big numerals, balls, dots and meter fills, never small text; small red text uses --danger.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Each theme has a single accent. Colour beyond it is a project colour (data) or a status (state), never decoration.

rules.name: The Three Sizes Rule
rules.body: Figure, body, small. Rank is made with case, weight and tracking, not with a fourth size.

rules.name: The Even Digits Rule
rules.body: Every figure is tabular so ticking clocks do not jitter.

rules.name: The One Layout Rule
rules.body: Themes restyle; they do not restructure. A new screen is built once with panel, row, section head and the ribbon, and all three themes dress it.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from lines, tone and the band, never from a shadow.

dos: Do use .num for every figure and keep the three text sizes (15, 13, figure).
Do carry a project's ribbon colour on every task and log row, ball and bar.
Do keep one accent per theme and one gold (or ink, or mint) primary action in the header.
Do set any new token in all three theme blocks, status colours included, and check AA (4.5:1 text, 3:1 large figures and control outlines).
Do make dialogs with ModalShell and icon buttons with IconButton.
donts: Don't add a sidebar of navigation or a grid of stat cards; the band is the dashboard.
Don't put clock phase colours (near, due, over) on small text.
Don't use shadows, glass, glow or gradients for depth.
Don't change layout per theme; change only type, palette, density, radius and the signature move.
Don't use text-[10px] or any text under 12px.
